data.one_liner: Provides WebDriver bindings for Dart to interact with a WebDriver remote server.
data.what_it_does: Provides WebDriver bindings for Dart supporting both the WebDriver JSON interface and W3C spec. It allows you to control web browsers via a WebDriver remote server using asynchronous or synchronous APIs.
use_when: You need to write browser automation or integration tests in Dart.
You want to communicate with a WebDriver remote server like chromedriver or geckodriver.
avoid_when: You are building standard cross-platform UI applications without browser testing needs.
You do not have a WebDriver remote server available to run against.
strengths: Supports both JSON wire spec and W3C spec.
Offers both asynchronous and synchronous APIs.
weaknesses: Requires an external WebDriver remote server (such as chromedriver or geckodriver) to run.
Running tests can be complex and slow.
data.setup_notes: Requires downloading and launching an external WebDriver binary like chromedriver or geckodriver.
